H001047.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
H001047.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
H001047.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
